title: Overlay Taxonomy & Stacking Rules
principles: Overlay family is classification, not implicit precedence.
No last-write-wins behavior is permitted for overlay conflicts.
All overlay changes are explicit typed deltas against environment property domains.
Equivalent effects are deduplicated through stable effect keys and declared stack modes.
Unresolvable conflicts remain visible validation states rather than being guessed.
Overlay definitions never mutate archetypes, presets, local instances, source profiles, participant records, or runtime-owned state.
Post-apocalyptic, cyberpunk, ruined, and similar broad styles/states are not automatically monolithic overlays when they can be composed from narrower reusable conditions.

overlay_families.name: Weather & Precipitation
overlay_families.scope: Transient or persistent meteorological conditions such as rain, snow, fog, storm, wind, or severe weather.

overlay_families.name: Temperature & Thermal
overlay_families.scope: Heat/cold conditions that alter the thermal envelope without defining the underlying terrain identity.

overlay_families.name: Hydrology & Water State
overlay_families.scope: Flooding, drought, water level, current/surge, saturation, ice cover, or other water-state changes.

overlay_families.name: Atmosphere & Air Quality
overlay_families.scope: Breathability, gas composition, smoke, particulates, corrosive or toxic air, and atmospheric contamination.

overlay_families.name: Light & Visibility
overlay_families.scope: Darkness, glare, obscuration, haze, unusual illumination, or visibility conditions not intrinsic to the archetype.

overlay_families.name: Gravity & Inertial Conditions
overlay_families.scope: Low, high, zero, variable, or otherwise altered gravity/inertial regimes.

overlay_families.name: Pressure
overlay_families.scope: Atmospheric, hydrostatic, or other pressure deviations and gradients beyond the baseline environment.

overlay_families.name: Radiation & Contamination
overlay_families.scope: Radiation, chemical contamination, biological contamination, pollution, fallout, or comparable hazardous environmental contamination.

overlay_families.name: Geologic & Physical Disaster
overlay_families.scope: Volcanic activity, earthquakes, landslides, avalanches, unstable ground, ashfall, or other physical-event conditions.

overlay_families.name: Ecological & Landscape State
overlay_families.scope: Overgrowth, die-off, wildfire state, invasive growth, severe erosion, blight, or other landscape/ecology conditions that can recur across archetypes.

overlay_families.name: Infrastructure & Operational State
overlay_families.scope: Abandoned, derelict, damaged, powered-down, failing-life-support, blackout, or other operational conditions of constructed environments.

overlay_families.name: Magical, Supernatural & Multiversal Influence
overlay_families.scope: Magical saturation/dead zones, reality instability, dimensional bleed, psychic influence, corruption, temporal disturbance, Chaos/Foam influence, Dream influence, or comparable nonordinary conditions.

scope_contract.activation_may_be_scoped_to: environment, local instance, route/zone/volume, or runtime-owned scene scope

stacking_pipeline.rule: Reject missing references and mark unsupported overlays when applicability predicates fail; do not silently coerce.
Resolve aliases to stable overlay IDs and compare only activations whose scopes materially overlap.

Multiple activations of the same overlay identity in the same scope merge only according to that overlay's declared intensity/duration/parameter merge policy; otherwise they are redundant or unresolved.
Apply explicit requires/excludes/supersedes/transforms_with relations. Absence of a relation does not imply conflict.
Compile each active overlay to target-domain deltas while preserving overlay and source provenance.

Group contributions by effect_key. Nonstacking effects apply once; strongest/weakest compare only on declared comparable scales; additive/multiplicative effects combine only when explicitly declared stackable; incomparable competing values become unresolved_conflict.
Apply explicit amplifies/dampens/transforms_with interactions. Never invent interaction math from overlay names alone.
Conflicting set/replace/constrain operations on the same target property require an explicit relation or merge rule; otherwise mark unresolved_conflict.
Emit a derived contribution trace containing applied, suppressed, transformed, redundant, and unresolved contributions without mutating durable definitions.

deduplication_rules: Every mechanical or semantic environmental effect intended to participate in stacking must expose a stable effect_key.
Two overlays may both remain active while one duplicate effect contribution is suppressed.
Suppressing a duplicate effect never suppresses unrelated effects from the same overlay.
When two nonstacking contributions to one effect_key differ and no comparison rule exists, resolution is unresolved_conflict rather than arbitrary selection.
Hazard, encounter, resource, and Habitat Signature hooks use the same unique-reference/deduplication principle where applicable.
compatibility_rules: Family membership alone never makes two overlays compatible or incompatible.
Different families may conflict when they write incompatible values to the same property or carry explicit exclusion relations.
Same-family overlays may coexist when their phenomena differ or their scopes do not overlap.
Exclusive groups represent mutually exclusive regimes, not generic family-level exclusion.
An overlay may be valid but redundant against an archetype/preset baseline; redundancy is reported rather than treated as an error when no effect is lost.
An overlay that requires a physical medium or structural condition absent from the resolved base is unsupported unless an authored transformation rule supplies that condition.

composition_examples.rule: Both may remain active. Any shared movement/visibility/hydrology effects deduplicate by effect_key; additional flood depth is not inferred unless an authored amplify relation exists.

composition_examples.case: Low Gravity + Zero Gravity in same scope
composition_examples.rule: Both target the gravity regime. If Zero Gravity declares supersession within the same exclusive group, Low Gravity is superseded; otherwise conflict is visible.
Separate contamination/atmosphere effects may coexist and contribute independently unless a specific interaction is authored.
Heavy Rain does not automatically extinguish Wildfire. A dampens/transforms relation may later define that behavior.
Both infrastructure-state overlays may coexist; shared power-loss effects deduplicate while abandonment retains distinct access, maintenance, resource, and encounter implications.
ENV-13 may author amplification/transformation; ENV-04 does not invent one.

non_overlay_guidance.post_apocalyptic: Treat as a preset/local-state composition of narrower conditions when possible (for example dereliction, contamination, overgrowth, flooding, scarcity/context), not one universal overlay.
non_overlay_guidance.cyberpunk: Primarily presentation/technology/social style or preset/local context, not automatically an environmental condition overlay.
non_overlay_guidance.ruined: May be represented through infrastructure/structural state when reusable, while ruin identity/lore may remain preset/local-instance content.
non_overlay_guidance.climate_band: Stable climate belongs in archetype/preset parameterization when intrinsic; transient or exceptional departures belong in overlays.
